recorded.prompt:q-negated-scope:a: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.

recorded.outcome:q-negated-scope:a: ruled out: Pitfall 3 code: inside `if (!(obj instanceof String s)) {` the comment says "// s is NOT available here"; Q3 scope rules: "In negated conditions: available in the else branch". (Note: Pitfall 3's heading comment "pattern variable 's' is not in scope in the else branch" misstates this and contradicts its own code comments; the code comments and Q3 still decide it.)
recorded.prompt:q-negated-scope:c: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.

recorded.outcome:q-negated-scope:c: ruled out: Q3: "The pattern variable is in scope only where the compiler can prove the match succeeded" and "In negated conditions: available in the else branch"; Pitfall 3 "s is NOT available here" in the then-branch.
recorded.prompt:q-closing-right:b: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.
